scope: Read-only private packages/safejs/src and .git/refs inventories include path/type/mode/size/mtime/ctime and hashes, root-directory metadata, additions/removals; exact metadata files listed separately. Selected external tool files and public sealed references are guarded. Excludes other private packages, dist, node_modules, caches, logs/reflogs, object-store membership and atime; selected-tool sibling additions are not checked. No clean-state assumption, no whole-private unchanged or transactional/ABA guarantee; preexisting dirtiness remains untouched. Guards run before every child/copy stage and after children/final cleanup only on later GO, never as preparation proof.
